versions.changelog:
Initial release — provides powerful Douyin (TikTok China) data access and analysis via multiple real-time APIs:

- Supports video/image search by keyword with flexible filters (likes, publish time, duration, content type).
- Fetches real-time Douyin rising hot trends and category-based hot terms.
- Scrapes public posts from Douyin creators via homepage link or sec_uid.
- Analyzes comments on Douyin videos by URL or aweme_id, including content and engagement data.
- Designed for topic research, competitor analysis, trend tracking, public opinion monitoring, and short video operations.
